title: b_common.arenaOf() wall scan starts at the centre column: inverted arena (w = -48) when the centre is solid (s15 Moloch altar)
actual: arenaOf(): the left/right wall scan starts at the arena's centre column and stops at the first solid column, so when the centre column is solid terrain the result is inverted (s15 boss room, Moloch's altar: centre col 36 is a plinth -> x0 1776 > x1 1728, w = -48). Suggested fix: scan inward from world.arena.x0/x1 and treat only contiguous solid columns at floor-1/floor-2 touching the arena edge as walls (same rule as c_common.js fixArena). Verified that this rule gives identical bounds for all 13 Part 1 boss rooms and s14.
hint: Scan inward from world.arena.x0/x1 and treat only contiguous solid columns touching the edge as walls.

title: Dracula form 2 screen clamp margin too small (wings off screen) and the clamp drags the boss with the camera
actual: Form 2 (true form) screen clamp: s_d_idle does `this.x = clamp(this.cx, max(viewX(200)[0], A.x0+200), min(viewX(200)[1], A.x1-200))` on every walking frame, and becomeDemon() clamps to viewX(230). (a) Use a margin of at least 300·d2.scale for form 2 (e.g. viewX(300)) in both places so the wings stay on screen; (b) cap how fast the clamp may move the boss (e.g. at most 160 px/s) so it does not slide along with the camera edge; or drop the per-frame clamp and let it just walk. Low severity, gameplay unchanged otherwise.
hint: Use viewX(300*scale) in s_d_idle and becomeDemon(); cap the clamp correction speed (~160 px/s).
